description: This file defines the FastAPI routes for managing background jobs in the branding compliance backend. It includes models for request/response payloads, endpoints for creating, deleting, uploading assets, triggering analysis, fetching status/results, asset previews, fixing assets, and downloading reports. It interfaces with multiple services such as AnalyzerService, FixerService, and ReportService, and manages job-related state and workspace handling.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Request model to create a new job with optional owner, title, and description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the created job ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the status details of a job, including progress and issues info.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Request model for fixing a single asset with an optional strategy.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Request model for running batch fixes across assets.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new job, generating a UUID, initializing the workspace, and saving the job state.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a job and its workspace directory.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a zip of assets for a job, extracting its contents into the uploads folder.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload an old brand image for detection reference.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a new brand image for fixing overlays.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Trigger background analysis and image preview generation for a job.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Retrieve the current status and progress of a job.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Provide the current assets, issues, and summary for a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Serve a generated preview image for a specified asset, supporting different views.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Run an automatic fix on an individual asset and mark issues as fixed.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Apply automatic fixes to all assets with issues for a job.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Prepare and serve downloadable report or zip artifacts for a job.

methods.name: None _save_upload_to(path: Path, file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Helper to save uploaded files atomically to a destination path.
